title: E-GMT-0035: pacing a bulk triangle and summing the turns gives an angle deficit equal to its area (Gauss-Bonnet)...
purpose: Experiment E-GMT-0035 in the geometry arena: pacing a bulk triangle and summing the turns gives an angle deficit equal to its area (Gauss-Bonnet), matched to machine precision by two independent measurements and growing with loop size, while the same legs interpreted flatly give zero deficit.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
